summary: Regression of the change in folding free energy (ΔΔG) caused by a single-point mutation.
what_it_measures: ΔΔG (kcal/mol) of a point mutant relative to wild type, standardized (`ddg_standardized`). A mutation-delta task using the mutant-minus-wild-type embedding.
assay_method: Experimentally derived stability changes (ΔΔG) for single-point mutants, manually curated in FireProtDB.
provenance: The ΔΔG subset of FireProtDB (data dir `ddg_mut`); mutant sequences built by applying substitutions to the wild type.
when_to_use: The canonical stability-prediction regression for engineering; tests sensitivity of embedding deltas to destabilizing/stabilizing point mutations.
caveats: Sign convention and measurement noise matter; small and family-biased; single-point only. Standardized target (MAE in standardized units).

citations.title: FireProtDB: database of manually curated protein stability data
